about_the_game:
Your beloved city is under attack by three gargantuan Kaiju! They’re out of control! They’re destroying everything! They’re... actually kinda cute and totally misunderstood?

Meet the sweet and delicate Mortha, the peculiar (in a good way) Sephia, and the majestic force-of-nature Liz! These Kaiju Girls bring a whole new meaning to the word “crush” - in more ways than one. Only your love can quell the anger inside them, end their bitter rivalry, and bring peace back to the world! Plus, it’s going to be REALLY fun winning them over.

This bundle unlocks:

Three new fully-dateable characters for your Crush Crush game

  • Captivating voice performances for all three girls

  • An assortment of gorgeous Outfits (available at Lover level!)

  • Plus a few surprise features you’re sure to love!

Experience a Crush Crush love story like no other - with the Kaiju Bundle!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14.04 or newer or SteamOS
  • Processor: Modern Intel/AMD CPU 2GHz+
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX9 (shader model 2.0) capabilities. Anything made since 2004 should work.
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14.04 or newer or SteamOS
  • Processor: Modern Intel/AMD CPU 2GHz+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX9 (shader model 2.0) capabilities. Anything made since 2004 should work.
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
